plugin-translate-slot.name: Translate
plugin-translate-slot.description: Translate text with no-key server-side providers and natural language query matching.

defaultTarget.label: Default Target Language
defaultTarget.description: Target language to translate into if not specified.

libreTranslateUrl.description: Public or self-hosted LibreTranslate base URL. Leave blank to disable this provider.
